admission_scope: All 3251 supported causal raw replay episodes; 9.3M canonical reference records are not relabeled training-admitted.
authorization: User approved V2 admission, trainer integration, retraining and local league evaluation on 2026-10-25.
comparison_guard: Reject changed cache/data/splits, presentation order, budget, optimizer, selection, recurrent architecture or initialization; snapshot is an explicitly declared architecture comparison.
competing_explanations: No useful additional history in this replay population
A broken live adapter or fallback composition
follow_up_only_if: Consumption, learning and live-policy diagnostics pass; further scaling/confirmation is a new experiment rather than an inferred result of this pilot.
history_stream: Only the focal actor's own request observations, public log snapshots and completed past actions; no inactive-seat-only snapshots.
hypothesis: Ordered actor-visible history can improve imitation and exploratory gameplay compared with a rich current-observation policy and a parameter-matched null-history recurrent control.
league_engine_randomness: Unpaired; the inspected native BattleStart interface and official game API expose no game-seed argument. Policy RNG seeds do not seed engine chance.
league_interpretation: Single-training-seed exploratory diagnostic, per-opponent binomial intervals and opponent-cluster aggregate uncertainty; no promotion or completed E11/E23 confirmation claim.
league_schedule: Each policy seed, each seat, two independent games; separate policy RNGs and newly reset agents for every game.
league_scope: Existing latest_training_population, exact locally available model/deck identities, plus D1 as a fresh control participant; no membership or champion changes.
limitations: Finite context window, not full-game BPTT
Small single-seed models and a bounded subset do not establish a model-capacity ceiling
Mixed replay quality and deck distribution
Unsupported prompts use a declared frozen fallback evaluated as part of the whole policy
selection: Minimum unweighted validation CE among trained checkpoints, evaluated every256updates and at final update; initialization is reported but excluded from selection.
stop: Nonfinite values, missing gradients/updates, identity/privacy/split/target failures, any illegal action/crash/timeout, or configured resource limit. No score-chasing budget extension.
